summary: Iterates the dword array starting at dword_7CE23C up to the unk_7CE24C sentinel. For each non-null slot it runs resource cleanup twice (ResourceCleanup_cd10), frees the saved pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zeroes the slot. Returns the last cleanup result. Used during UI/static teardown.

operations.description: Initialize slot pointer v0 to the array base dword_7CE23C.
Iterate the array from dword_7CE23C while the slot pointer is below the unk_7CE24C end sentinel.
If the current slot value *v0 is non-null, process it.
Run resource cleanup on *v0 via ResourceCleanup_cd10.
Save the current slot value into v2 for a later free.
If *v0 is still non-null after the first cleanup.
Run a second resource cleanup on *v0 via ResourceCleanup_cd10.
Free the saved pointer v2 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero the array slot *v0 after cleanup.

unresolved: The array element type and the concrete object type behind ResourceCleanup_cd10 are unverified; the double-cleanup of the same slot is taken from raw source verbatim and may reflect a deliberate or buggy original pattern.
